title: Noble Sissle's society band with Bechet and Ladnier
summary: He joins Noble Sissle's band at a hotel grill, working with Sidney Bechet, Tommy Ladnier and June Cole for a few months.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Anyway, I'm sorry. I got distracted because I'm thinking Lucky Roberts and Dick Dick Jazz Hangert (phonetic), but anyway, you -- you were starting to play duets and went to Noble Sissle in '31.

I went to Noble Sissle -- late '31, I went to Noble -- '32, in '32, I think. He used to play in the Florentine G-GRILL (phonetic) group, Park Center Hotel. They call it Park Sheraton today. So there I play -- he play like a kind of -- kind of society called a band with a match -- naturally they got a few good jazz numbers, because they had a guy like Sidney Gibbon (phonetic), Bechet, the soprano player.
Sidney Bechet. He was featured in that band.
They had a guy like Tommy Ladnier, trumpet player. He was a feature too. He (inaudible) them too, later.
And they had a -- they had Nat King
Cole's brother was playing the bass, June Cole, that and (inaudible) the kind of players that was in that band. They had a hell of a -- different guys.
So from there I stayed with that band maybe about three or four, five months (inaudible). something like that
Did you get to know Bechet and Ladnier?
Oh, yeah, I worked with them in there.
